'''2004 Washington State Championship Keith Watabayashi LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Keith Watabayashi]] at [[2004 Washington State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Keith "Gen" Watabayashi (2004-06-16).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=32807 Gouda--WA States 1st Place]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050525170114/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=32807&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
